## Actuaries in Vietnam: a profession on the rise

<!-- Optional slide for Vietnamese prospective students, switched by
     `show.vietnam` in _quarto.yml (or --profile vietnam). Facts are from
     Odierno, Kau and Nguyen, "The Growing Strength of Actuaries in Vietnam",
     The Actuary (Society of Actuaries), January 2021. Figures date from
     2019-2020; check the regulations are current before each session. -->

::: {.cards .cards-jobs}
::: {.card .fragment}
**Young and growing fast**

Life insurance in Vietnam is only about 20 years old. At first, foreign experts held every key actuarial job. Now Vietnamese actuaries are CEOs and CFOs of major insurers.
:::
::: {.card .fragment}
**Required by law**

Since 2016, every insurer in Vietnam must have a qualified actuary. They approve new products and prices, check that enough money is set aside for claims, and test the company's financial strength every month.
:::
::: {.card .fragment}
**More students than ever**

Vietnamese candidates sitting Society of Actuaries (SOA) exams rose almost 70% in five years. The first actuarial degrees opened in Hanoi (2018) and Ho Chi Minh City (2019).
:::
:::

::: {.keyphrase .fragment .vn-close}
Vietnam's top actuarial roles need an international fellowship, such as the SOA's. ANU is an SOA Centre of Actuarial Excellence.
:::

[Source: H. S. Odierno, S. H. Kau and N. Nguyen, "The Growing Strength of Actuaries in Vietnam", *The Actuary* (Society of Actuaries), January 2021.]{.source-line}

::: {.notes}
About 1 min, for Vietnamese students or schools. Examples for card 1: Vietnamese actuaries have been CEO of Aviva and FWD Vietnam and CFO of AIA, FWD and Dai-ichi Vietnam. Card 3: 220+ candidates sat SOA exams in Vietnam in 2019; the degrees are at the National Economics University (Hanoi) and the University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City (UEH). The 2016 rule is Decree 76: the appointed actuary of a life insurer must be a fellow of an international body such as the SOA, with 10 years in life and health insurance or 5 years after qualifying, and must live in Vietnam. Non-life insurers need at least an associate. The article is from 2021, so the numbers will have grown since; check the current rules before quoting them as up to date.
:::
